E-fill0.label: Earnings gap triggers the fill (reaction on the fill day)

E-hold5.label: Earnings within 5 sessions after the fill (not the fill day)

E-hold10.label: Earnings within 10 sessions after the fill (not the fill day)

E-0to5.label: Earnings on the fill day or within 5 sessions after

E-0to10.label: Earnings on the fill day or within 10 sessions after

E-setup7.label: Earnings within 7 sessions of the setup day (card warning today)

E-setup15.label: Earnings within 15 sessions of the setup day

M-pin1.label: Deal pin: +15% jump on 4x volume in the last 15 sessions, then avg daily range < 1%

M-pin15.label: Deal pin: same, avg daily range < 1.5%

G-gap3.label: Fill bar opens > 3% above the pivot (gap through the buy stop)

G-gap5.label: Fill bar opens > 5% above the pivot

G-gap8.label: Fill bar opens > 8% above the pivot

E-fill0+G-gap3.label: Earnings-gap fill or open > 3% above the pivot

R-risk10.label: Structural risk > 10% (stop clamped well inside the structure)

adopted.label: HTF + earnings-session skip + gap limit 3% + deal pin
